prompt: A compound shows IR bands at 3300 cm⁻¹ (sharp) and 2100 cm⁻¹ (weak). What functional group is present?

options.label: Terminal alkyne — sharp sp C–H at 3300, weak C≡C at 2100
Internal alkyne — strong C≡C at 2100, sp² C–H at 3300
Nitrile — sharp C≡N at 2250, N–H at 3300 from hydrolysis
Alcohol-alkene — broad O-H at 3300, weak C=C at 2100

explanation: Terminal alkynes have a sharp sp C–H stretch at ~3300 (unique position) and a weak C≡C at ~2100. Internal alkynes lack sp C–H and often have NO visible C≡C (symmetric → no dipole change). Nitriles are at ~2250, not 2100. Alkenes don't show at 2100.
